question: Which compound has the chemical formula CHCl₃ whose melting point is 209 K?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Chloroform.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Chloroform, or trichloromethane, is an **organic compound** with the formula CHCl3. 
 
• It is a **colourless, strong-smelling**, dense liquid that is produced on a large scale as a precursor to** PTFE**. 
 
• It is also a precursor to various refrigerants. It is one of the four chloromethanes and a trihalomethane.
 
• Chloroform is used **as a solvent, a substance that helps other substances dissolve**.
 
• Also, it is used in the building, paper, and board industries, and in **pesticide and film production.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Carbon tetrachloride chemical structure. CCl4 is **a clear, nonflammable, heavy liquid that evaporates readily, producing a sweet characteristic odour similar to chloroform.**​ 
 
• A chlorophenol is any organochloride of phenol that contains one or more covalently bonded chlorine atoms.
 
• 2-Chloroethanol is primarily used for the **synthesis of ethylene oxide and a number of synthetic reactions for the preparation of dyes, pharmaceuticals, biocides, and plasticizers**.
 
• It is also used for the **manufacture of thiodiglycol.**
